pages.title: Acme Corp Internal Portal
pages.content: Welcome to the Acme Corp internal portal. Use the navigation menu to access HR, Finance, Engineering, and Product tools.

pages.title: New Employee Onboarding Guide
pages.content: This guide covers your first 30 days at Acme Corp: equipment setup, benefits enrollment, team introductions, and mandatory compliance training. Contact your manager with questions.

pages.title: PTO and Leave Policy
pages.content: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of PTO per year. Unused PTO rolls over up to a maximum of 10 days. Submit leave requests at least 5 business days in advance through the HR portal.

pages.title: Engineering Wiki – Development Standards
pages.content: Our development standards include: Git branching with feature branches off main, mandatory code review by at least one peer, CI must be green before merge, and weekly dependency audits.
